prompt: Bug report: with the TENOFF coupon ($10.00 off) on a single $100.00 desk lamp, checkout shows tax $20.00 and total $110.00. Our policy is that every discount reduces the taxable amount, so the tax should be $18.00 and the total $108.00. A discount larger than the order must never make the taxable amount, the tax, or the total negative. Fix it and keep the existing tests passing.
